newsitem.title: USA: Zaxis gets FDA OK for lipoprotein kit.
newsitem.headline: Zaxis gets FDA OK for lipoprotein kit.

text.p: Zaxis International Inc said it had received pre-market notification from the Food and Drug Administration for Zaxis' LFS Lipogel Assay Kit.

The company said in a statement it "views this as a significant step in the search for means to identify heart disease factors attracting heavy media attention in recent weeks, such as so called 'bad vs. good cholesterol' components."

The Assay Kit is one of the principal components of the Zaxis Lipo Fractionation System which provides measurements of lipoprotein levels in blood serum. The new system is intended to enhance the cholesterol analytical process by generating accurate readings of High Density Lipoproteins, Low Density Lipoproteins and Very Low Density Lipoproteins, all from very small samples subjected to a single test.
